title: MPEG-TS track elimination with payload preservation

definition.title: MPEG-TS track elimination with payload preservation
definition.source_excerpt: The source transport contains one H.264 stream and two AAC tracks. Rebuilding the TS with only video + first audio preserves all 150 video packet payload hashes and all 236 selected-audio payload hashes. The unused 236 AAC packets are absent. Transport size falls from 345,920 to 281,248 bytes, a 18.7% reduction. This validates a payload-preserving track-pruning route; the TS container itself must still be rebuilt because PAT/PMT/PID/PCR/continuity semantics belong to the output transport.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
